judge.reason: It declines to guess, gives the reason, names no competitors and asks for URLs, but it never says compare will be skipped without competitors. It only offers a single-site assessment, which doesn't state that consequence.

reply:
I can't choose the competitors for this run, even though you asked me to. The compare method requires you to supply them and never lets me guess. I checked for a saved Nimbus Notes target that might already list some, and there isn't one.

The reason is practical: the comparison is only as good as the sites in it. If I pick the wrong ones, the differences matrix still looks confident and well-evidenced, and nothing in the report would show you that the choice was my guess rather than yours. You may care most about a site that wouldn't be the obvious pick.

**To proceed, send me 1–3 competitor URLs.** Rough is fine; "the two we lose deals to" or "the ones our sales team mentions" works if you can give me their domains.

Once I have them, I'll show you the run shape and time estimate before starting. Each site is captured separately: logged out, using the same persona and depth, with no accounts created and no forms submitted. Each is scored separately, and then everything is diffed. For 3 sites (yours plus two), expect about 1h 30m to 1h 50m.

**If you don't have any to name,** I can run a single-site website assessment of example-nimbus-notes.test with `/understudy:run` instead. It covers clarity, conversion, trust and the other lenses, just without the side-by-side matrix.
